name: @rello-platform/metric-keys
description: Canonical PlatformMetricSnapshot metricKey registry for the Rello platform — exact emitted literals + interpolated family prefixes + listActiveMetricKeys() SOT primitive.
comment:exports: Single-format ESM ON PURPOSE (slugs/signals precedent). CJS consumers require() this entry; Node >=22 require(esm) loads it (no top-level await) and every transitive import resolves via ESM. We expose the SAME ESM file under import/require/default so a CJS consumer cannot crash with ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED. (feedback-esm-only-rello-package-into-cjs-add-require-condition-not-dual-build.)
